# nd_deploy_history (Data Source)

Reads deployment history records for a fabric from the Nexus Dashboard API.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "nd_deploy_history" "test_datasource_deploy_history_1" {
  fabric_name = "fabric1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `fabric_name` (String) Fabric name used to retrieve deployment history records.

### Optional

- `no_of_records` (Number) Number of deployment history records to retrieve. Defaults to 10 when not specified.

### Read-Only

- `deployment_records` (Attributes List) Deployment history records returned for the fabric. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--deployment_records))

<a id="nestedatt--deployment_records"></a>
### Nested Schema for `deployment_records`

Read-Only:

- `complete_timestamp` (String) Timestamp when the deployment completed.
- `config_command_responses` (Attributes List) Execution responses for the deployment configuration commands. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--deployment_records--config_command_responses))
- `entity_name` (String) Name of the deployment entity.
- `entity_type` (String) Type of the deployment entity.
- `hostname` (String) Hostname of the switch associated with the deployment.
- `secondary_entity_name` (String) Name of the secondary entity associated with the deployment.
- `secondary_entity_type` (String) Type of the secondary entity associated with the deployment.
- `source` (String) Source of the deployment record.
- `start_timestamp` (String) Timestamp when the deployment started.
- `status` (String) Status of the deployment.
- `status_description` (String) Description of the deployment status.
- `switch_id` (String) Identifier of the switch associated with the deployment.
- `switch_ip` (String) IP address of the switch associated with the deployment.
- `ticket_id` (String) Identifier of the ticket associated with the deployment.
- `username` (String) Username associated with the deployment.

<a id="nestedatt--deployment_records--config_command_responses"></a>
### Nested Schema for `deployment_records.config_command_responses`

Read-Only:

- `cli_response` (String) CLI response returned by the configuration command.
- `command` (String) Configuration command executed on the switch.
- `complete_timestamp` (String) Timestamp when the configuration command completed.
- `status` (String) Status returned for the configuration command.
